segment.source: Renders the ask to start a free trial with the objections answered right next to the button: no card, cancel any time, how many days, how long setup takes. Use it for: SaaS landing pages, the end of a product tour, the band above a pricing table, a campaign page. Prefer 'Trial Terms Panel' when the mechanics need a proper specification rather than three reassurances, and 'Demo Booking Band' when a guided walk-through suits the audience better.
